narrative.title: The Badge That Never Checked In
narrative.scenario: An access-control system issues badges numbered 0 through n, and an end-of-day audit dumps every badge that badged in exactly once. Exactly one badge is missing from the dump. Identify it without sorting the attendance log.
narrative.inputFormat: An array nums of n distinct integers drawn from the range [0, n].
narrative.outputFormat: The single integer in [0, n] that does not appear in nums.
constraints: All values in nums are distinct

testCases.explanation: The badges 0,1,3 checked in, so the untouched badge in [0,3] is 2.
With two entries present, the range is [0,2] and the absent badge is the upper bound itself.

hintLevels: Level 1: The full set of badge numbers is known in advance, so compare what the log contains against what it should contain.
Level 2: Sum the closed series 0..n with the standard formula, subtract the sum of the log and the difference is the absent badge.
Level 3: The missing badge can be n itself, so the series length must come from the array size rather than from the largest value you observe.
